description: This file defines an enum for transaction statuses and extension methods for handling these statuses within the Orleans.Transaction framework, including conversion to user exceptions and status checks.

classes.name: TransactionalStatusExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the TransactionalStatus enum, including status evaluation and conversion to exceptions.

methods.name: DefinitelyAborted
methods.description: Determines if the transaction status indicates a definite abort.

methods.name: ConvertToUserException
methods.description: Converts a transaction status into a specific user exception applicable to the transaction outcome.
